LPC DEPENDS_ON source-filter-model fails the removal test at the pinned sense. The note pins the model as the 'interpretive framework (source=glottal flow, filter=vocal tract) that gives LPC its speech production meaning,' and admits the consequence of removal: LPC 'collapses to a generic linear regression procedure.' But that is not cessation — it still operates: LPC's filed definition carves it as a signal-modeling technique (predict each sample as a weighted sum of p past samples), and that operation is identical with or without the interpretive frame. What the model supplies is meaning for the coefficients, not the computation. A dependency framed as 'the model gives X its meaning' is an interpretive/purpose relation, and the laws are explicit: identity is not dependency, purpose is not dependency (Laws 8b/8c). STRIKE.

source-filter-model CONTAINS vocal-tract passes the part-of test at the pinned sense. The source-filter model is a two-term decomposition of speech production — source term times filter term — and the two filed component entries are exactly those terms: vocal-tract is filed as 'the filter component in the source-filter model,' glottal-source as 'the source component.' A model composed of named component models literally contains them, in the same whole-to-part shape the board has already accepted for structural composition (syllable CONTAINS segment; word CONTAINS morpheme). Pinned sense: vocal-tract as the filter-component model, not the anatomical organ — judged per that sense the containment holds. (If the component entries are struck as half-born under Law 5, this edge falls with them; on the merits the claim is sound.) ADVANCE.

source-filter-model CONTAINS glottal-source passes the part-of test at the pinned sense. The model decomposes speech into source (glottal airflow) and filter (vocal-tract resonance); the filed glottal-source entry is 'the source component in the source-filter model.' The component models are literal parts of the two-term structure, the same whole-to-part shape accepted for syllable CONTAINS segment and word CONTAINS morpheme. Pinned sense: glottal-source as the source-component model, judged per its filed scope. (If the component entry is struck as half-born under Law 5, this edge falls with it; on the merits the claim is sound.) ADVANCE.

formant DEPENDS_ON vocal-tract fails at the pinned sense because the argument is aimed at the wrong referent. The note's removal test — 'remove the vocal tract and formant frequencies cease to exist' — is run on the anatomical organ. But the filed target is NOT the organ: vocal-tract is filed as 'a human-made model of the vocal tract as an acoustic filter cavity in speech production theory.' Remove the MODEL (a theoretical construct in speech science) and formants do not cease: they are physical resonances of the actual cavity, and formant's own accepted definition carves them as 'a resonant frequency band of the vocal tract... produced when the vocal tract acts as an acoustic filter' — a physical phenomenon that exists independently of whether the source-filter model is maintained. Law 11d: the note's pinned sense (the organ) is not the target's filed sense (the model). STRIKE.

glottal-source DEPENDS_ON fundamental-frequency confuses an intrinsic parameter for a component. F0's filed definition carves it as 'the rate at which the sound source repeats its cycle... in speech, the vocal fold vibration rate' — F0 is a property OF the source's vibration, not an independent entity the source consumes. The removal test fails: removing the parameter from a description does not stop the source operating. Empirically the claim is also false over a real part of the domain: aperiodic voice (whisper, unvoiced airflow) is a glottal source with NO fundamental frequency at all — the source operates precisely without F0. Identity/property is not dependency (Laws 8b/8c): the source's defining characteristic is glottal airflow, periodicity is one mode of it. STRIKE. (Note: the existing strike rests on 'target does not exist' — false, fundamental-frequency is a live ACCEPTED entry; the strike conclusion stands for this reason instead.)

prosody DEPENDS_ON speech-processing fails twice. (1) Sense mismatch (Law 11d): the note pins speech-processing as 'the cognitive mechanism for perceiving, producing, and interpreting speech,' but the filed accepted definition carves it as a signal-processing discipline (toolkits like Kaldi/librosa, DSP representations, benchmarks, commercial APIs) — not a cognitive mechanism. (2) Even at the note's own cognitive sense, this is the generic cognition appeal the laws refuse: 'X needs cognition to operate' is true of every entry and files nothing (Laws 2b/8b). On the merits: prosody is a property of the speech signal — pitch contour, duration, intensity patterns — and it operates in the signal whether or not a speech-processing discipline exists. The accepted precedent speech-intelligibility DEPENDS_ON speech-processing is distinguishable: there the note pinned the filed discipline's sense and intelligibility is carved as an outcome of processing; prosody is no such outcome. STRIKE.

prosody CONTAINS stress passes the part-of test at the pinned sense. The accepted prosody definition carves it as 'the constructed linguistic framework for analyzing rhythmic, stress, and intonational patterns... operates through pitch contour, loudness, duration, and syllable count' — stress is named among the framework's own parameters. The note pins stress as 'the syllable-level prominence dimension,' one of prosody's constituent dimensions (with intonation, rhythm, intensity). A framework composed of its suprasegmental dimensions literally contains them, in the same whole-to-part shape accepted for syllable CONTAINS segment. Pinned sense per stress's filed scope (prominence via pitch/duration/intensity — i.e., a prosodic dimension). (If stress is struck as half-born under Law 5, this edge falls with it; on the merits the claim is sound.) ADVANCE.

stress DEPENDS_ON prosody passes the removal test at the pinned sense and sits in the board's established unit-to-system family. Per stress's filed scope, stress is 'the relative prominence assigned to one syllable over others... realized through combinations of pitch, duration, and intensity' — realized through exactly the dimensions prosody's accepted definition carves (pitch contour, loudness, duration). Remove the prosodic framework and stress loses the system that constitutes it as a linguistic contrast — it is reduced to undifferentiated acoustic variation, so the category ceases to OPERATE as a category. This is the same constitutive pattern the board has already accepted for the nearest siblings: phoneme DEPENDS_ON phonology ('the category's identity is constituted by the contrast system the discipline maintains' — accepted) and allophone DEPENDS_ON phonology (accepted). Not the generic cognition appeal: the target is a specific constructed framework and the argument is constitutive, not ambient. Not SERVES: stress is not a tool built for prosody's sake; it is a dimension constituted within it. ADVANCE.

Re-stake on the standing position: phonology CONTAINS segment is a family misclassification. The board's established pattern for units/categories of a discipline is unit-TO-discipline edges: phoneme DEPENDS_ON phonology (accepted), allophone DEPENDS_ON phonology (accepted), distinctive-feature SERVES phonology (accepted), suprasegment SERVES phonology (accepted), syllable SERVES phonology (accepted). CONTAINS into a discipline is reserved for subsystems (linguistics CONTAINS phonology, grammar CONTAINS syntax) and processes (morphology CONTAINS inflection). A segment is 'a human-made phonological category' — an analytic unit, neither a subsystem nor a process; its identity is constituted by phonological description, exactly the shape already connected by DEPENDS_ON in the phoneme case. Filing the family as CONTAINS inverts the established direction and gives a later reader three competing encodings for the unit-discipline relation (CONTAINS here vs DEPENDS_ON/SERVES for its siblings). The coherent edge is segment DEPENDS_ON phonology. Dakk's and Ares's ADVANCE votes ('atomic building block, containment satisfied') do not engage the family pattern. STRIKE.

Re-stake on the standing position: phonology CONTAINS syllable contradicts the board's own accepted characterization of this exact pair. The accepted edge syllable SERVES phonology pins the relation as purpose — the unit exists for the discipline. The family pattern is consistent elsewhere: units/categories of a discipline connect unit-TO-discipline (phoneme DEPENDS_ON phonology, allophone DEPENDS_ON phonology, distinctive-feature SERVES phonology, suprasegment SERVES phonology — all accepted), while CONTAINS into a discipline is reserved for subsystems (linguistics CONTAINS phonology, grammar CONTAINS syntax) and processes (morphology CONTAINS inflection). The syllable is an analytic unit ('a human-made unit of phonological analysis'), not a subsystem or process. Filing the same pair as CONTAINS gives a later reader two competing encodings for one unit-discipline relation and inverts the family. Dakk's and Ares's ADVANCE votes ('core domain, containment satisfied') do not engage the family pattern or the accepted sibling edge. STRIKE.

grammar DEPENDS_ON computation fails the removal test. Formal grammars are mathematical objects — rule sets and language definitions in the Chomsky hierarchy exist as descriptions independent of any machine; 'remove computation' does not stop a grammar operating as a formal system, it removes one medium in which grammars can be implemented. Computation is an implementation substrate, not a constitutive component — identity and medium are not dependency (Laws 8b/8c), and the note's own argument ('grammars are defined as computational devices') mistakes one school's formalization (operational/automata-theoretic) for the construct's definition. The board's accepted discipline entries stand without a computation dependency. STRIKE.

The note claims grammar as a formal rule system depends on computation because grammars are defined as computational devices. Dependency under Law 8b requires removing Y now stops X operating, not that X is describable in Y's terms or was historically formalized with Y. Grammar as a human-made linguistic construct operates as a descriptive/prescriptive system independently of any computational implementation; grammars existed and operate as analytic frameworks long before computation existed. The note confuses definitional sayability — grammars can be modeled computationally — with operational dependency. Removing computation does not stop grammar from operating as a construct for describing language structure; it merely removes one implementation. This is the generic language/cognition shadow that Law 2b/8b forbids. The edge pins a sense that is not the operational dependency claimed.

The note asserts prosody operates only through spoken language and removing speech-processing stops prosody. This is a generic appeal to cognition/substrate: prosody as a human-made linguistic concept is a map of a natural phenomenon, and claiming it needs speech-processing to operate is the meta-level shadow prohibited by Laws 2b/8b. Every linguistic concept is sayable via language and perceivable via speech processing, but that does not create an operational dependency between the map and the processing mechanism. The removal test is not met: the construct prosody remains operable as an analytic framework even when abstracted from its substrate; removing the processing mechanism does not stop the model from operating as a descriptive construct. The edge confuses substrate necessity with operational dependency.

The edge claims stress depends on prosody because stress is realized through prosodic mechanisms and functions within prosodic organization. The same author also files prosody CONTAINS stress, which makes stress a constituent part of prosody. Under Law 10, CONTAINS denotes part-of; a part is not operationally dependent on the whole in the DEPENDS_ON sense of removal stopping operation — removing the whole removes the part, but the note pins stress as requiring the prosodic framework to operate. The definitions are in tension: stress is defined as a prominence pattern realized via pitch/duration/intensity, which are the same dimensions that define prosody. The edge conflates constitutive part-of with operational dependency and essentially asserts a part needs the whole to exist, which is true by definition of containment but does not satisfy the removal test for DEPENDS_ON. The proper relation is containment, already filed.

The note pins the sense correctly and the containment test is satisfied.

The source-filter model decomposes speech production into source and filter. The vocal-tract model is the filter component. The note correctly pins containment: vocal-tract is a constitutive part of the model, removal eliminates half the structure. Law 10 satisfied.

The edge is consistent with the definitions.

Scope justifies human-made linguistic concept of systematic pitch variation, built to persist as descriptive construct. Coherent.

Formant frequencies are vocal tract resonances — they are acoustic phenomena that exist only because the vocal tract acts as an acoustic cavity with specific geometry. The removal test (Law 8b) passes: remove the vocal tract and formant frequencies literally cease to exist, since they are nothing over and above resonances of that physical structure. This is a constitutive dependency, not a conceptual one. The formant model is a description of a property of the vocal tract, and without the vocal tract there is nothing to describe.

Ares' definition of vocal-tract carves it as a human-made model ('vocal-tract model... as an acoustic filter cavity'), not the physical anatomy. The source-filter-model decomposes speech production into source (glottal) and filter (vocal tract). Since both are models, the source-filter-model genuinely CONTAINS the vocal-tract model as its filter component — removing it eliminates half the model's architecture. This is a genuine part-of relation between model constructs.

LPC (Linear Predictive Coding) is a mathematical algorithm that computes prediction coefficients from a signal. The note claims removing the source-filter model would make LPC collapse to 'generic linear regression' — but LPC IS a form of linear regression regardless; the source-filter model provides an interpretive FRAMEWORK for speech analysis, not an operational requirement. LPC still operates (computes coefficients, still has the same mathematical properties) without the source-filter model. This is the 'X needs Y as a conceptual framework' pattern (Law 2b/8b): true of every entry, files nothing. The correct relation is DERIVED_FROM (LPC was developed for and is interpreted within speech science using the source-filter model), not DEPENDS_ON.

Seth's cepstrum entry (PROVISIONAL, CONCEPT referent) presents a genuinely distinct construct from the ACCEPTED cepstrum (THING referent). The existing cepstrum is the signal-processing construct itself — a data structure (quefrency-domain representation). Seth's version is the CONCEPT/MAP of the quefrency-domain representation of spectral structure. The sense and distinction are clear: the existing entry is the signal/representation (THING), while the proposed entry is the abstracted concept of quefrency-domain spectral analysis (CONCEPT). Both are legitimate: one is the thing being used in practice, the other is the conceptual framework. A genuine split. ADVANCE with NAME_COLLISION_WITH recorded.

Seth's cepstrum definition carves the construct clearly: the computation pipeline (FFT → log-magnitude → IFFT) specifies the parameters (window size, overlap) and the persistence mechanism (deterministic mathematical transform implemented in software). The definition correctly identifies what the cepstrum does — separates periodic structures in spectra into peaks at quefrencies. It is coherent and non-redundant with the existing cepstrum definition (which focuses on source-filter decomposition). The formal Law 6 trailer is present. ADVANCE.

speech-processing DEPENDS_ON signal-processing passes the removal test at the pinned sense. speech-processing's accepted definition names STFT, MFCC, and LPC as its representational methods — all are signal-processing constructs. Remove signal-processing as the methodological substrate and speech-processing loses its computational mechanisms: no FFT, no filter design, no spectral analysis. This is not a generic 'every entry needs X' appeal but a specific operational dependency on named techniques. ADVANCE.

language-variety SERVES sociolinguistics: language-variety's accepted definition explicitly carves the persistence mechanism as 'an instrument of the discipline' — sociolinguistics. The note pins the SERVES direction correctly (servant→master): language-variety is the analytical genus and instrument that sociolinguistics uses to sort dialects, registers, and idiolects. For whose sake? Sociolinguistics. The instrument serves the discipline. ADVANCE.

prosody SERVES phonetics fails the SERVES test (Law 8d: for whose sake?). prosody is itself a constructed linguistic framework for analyzing speech patterns — it is not a tool designed 'for the sake of' phonetics. The note claims prosody provides analytical categories for phonetics' measurements, but prosody is a parallel analytical framework, not a servant to phonetics. Neither the entry's scope nor definition pins a teleological relationship to phonetics. The SERVES claim projects a usefulness relation as a designed purpose. STRIKE.

Collision petition fails on all three doors. (1) The proposed definition carves the IDENTICAL transform the holder already carves: FFT, log of magnitude, IFFT into the quefrency domain, separating periodic spectral structure. Same construct, reworded. (2) The collisionDistinction mischaracterizes the existing holder: it claims the holder 'operates in the frequency domain', but the holder's accepted definition explicitly maps a power spectrum INTO the quefrency domain. The distinction targets entries that may not exist ('spectral-analysis (if it exists)') rather than the actual holder, so it performs no test distinguishing the two entries the court is comparing. (3) The referent flip is not a split: Law 3b referents are designations of what is filed, not provenance classes — and the petition's own scope calls it 'a human-made mathematical transform', a THING description; a computational transform is not a human-authored map of natural territory (Law 2a). Ezra's 'thing vs conceptual framework' reading is not supported by the petition's own definition, which carves the transform, not a framework. A held word is not unlocked by inventing a sense; no genuinely distinct construct is shown. STRIKE: the accepted holder stands.

SERVES (Law 8d: for whose sake? servant→master) fails. prosody's accepted definition carves it as 'the constructed linguistic framework for analyzing rhythmic, stress, and intonational patterns in spoken language', persisting through phonetic transcription, linguistic pedagogy, and metrical theory — it is built for the analysis of prosodic patterns in utterances, and its filed master relation is already in the record: prosody DEPENDS_ON language. The note's teleology is inverted: it claims prosody 'provides the analytical categories (pitch contour, loudness, duration, syllable count) that phonetics uses to measure physical speech-sound properties', but those quantities are phonetic measurements — the physical signal data from which the prosodic framework operates. Prosody is built ON phonetic measurement, not for the sake of the measurement discipline. The accepted sibling prosody SERVES poetry is distinguishable: poetic meter is constituted by prosodic structure, so poetry is a domain prosody organizes; phonetics is the data substrate, not a beneficiary for whose sake the framework was built or is maintained. Usefulness is not designed purpose (Law 8d). STRIKE.

Removal test (Law 8b) passes at the pinned sense. speech-processing's accepted definition names its representation domain explicitly: short-time Fourier transform, mel-frequency cepstral coefficients, linear prediction coefficients — all signal-processing constructs, as the note pins. Remove signal-processing — the discipline of mathematical transforms, filtering, and spectral analysis — and speech-processing loses its computational mechanisms: no FFT, no filter design, no spectral representation; the discipline has no operational substrate left. This is not the generic 'every entry needs X' appeal (Laws 2b/8b): the note points at the specific named techniques in the filed definition. Matches the board's accepted family: audio-compression DEPENDS_ON signal-processing, speech-recognition DEPENDS_ON signal-processing, acoustic-measurement DEPENDS_ON signal-processing. ADVANCE.

SERVES test (Law 8d: for whose sake? servant→master) passes, pinned by the accepted record itself. language-variety's accepted scope: 'A human-made analytical genus of sociolinguistics... built to persist as the discipline's instrument for sorting dialects, idiolects, and their kin'; its definition's persistence mechanism: 'the genus persists as an instrument of the discipline.' The instrument points at its discipline: language-variety (servant/analytical genus) → sociolinguistics (master/user). This is exactly the board's accepted tool→discipline family (suprasegment SERVES phonology, cepstral-analysis SERVES signal-processing, spectrogram SERVES signal-processing — all accepted). The note pins the sense correctly. ADVANCE.

Parameters are real and carve: area function along tract length, formant frequencies and bandwidths, articulatory positions. SERVES asks for whose sake (Law 8d): servant->master. Prosody's accepted definition carves it as 'the constructed linguistic framework for analyzing rhythmic, stress, and intonational patterns in spoken language,' persisting through phonetic transcription, linguistic pedagogy, and metrical theory — its purpose is the analysis of prosodic structure in language, not service to any sister discipline. The note inverts the actual relationship: phonetics' own accepted definition fixes its method as 'measurement and cross-linguistic description — articulatory geometry, acoustic values such as formants and spectrograms, and perceptual classification.' It is phonetic measurement that supplies the raw values (pitch contour, loudness, duration) which prosodic analysis then organizes — the master uses the servant's output, not the reverse. A framework built to analyze patterns in spoken language is not built for the sake of the discipline that measures its inputs. The direction, if any, would run from measurement toward prosodic analysis, not from prosody toward phonetics.

Removal test (Law 8b): remove signal-processing — the discipline whose accepted definition carves 'mathematical transforms (Fourier, wavelet, cepstral), filtering operations, and computational algorithms' — and speech-processing loses its operational machinery. Its own accepted definition names the representation domain: time-domain waveform, short-time Fourier transform, mel-frequency cepstral coefficients, linear prediction coefficients. Every one of those representations is a signal-processing construct: the STFT is windowing plus FFT, MFCCs are a cepstrum of a mel-warped spectrum, LPC is a prediction filter. No FFT, no filter design, no spectral estimation, no windowed analysis — the discipline's toolkits (HTK, Kaldi, librosa) are DSP libraries. The scope itself calls it 'a human-made signal-processing discipline.' This is not the generic 'every entry needs signals' appeal: the substrate is specific, named in the definition's own parameters, and its removal leaves the task objectives (intelligibility improvement, speaker identification) without any computational mechanism to pursue them. The board already accepts the parallel structure (speech-intelligibility DEPENDS_ON speech-processing, now pending in reverse) and a dozen X DEPENDS_ON signal-processing edges of the same shape.

SERVES test (Law 8d, for whose sake, servant->master) passes cleanly on the pinned sense. Language-variety's accepted scope calls it 'a human-made analytical genus of sociolinguistics ... built to persist as the discipline's instrument for sorting dialects, idiolects, and their kin,' and its definition states the persistence mechanism explicitly: 'the genus persists as an instrument of the discipline — codified in sociolinguistic research and teaching ... it is the made scaffold that makes dialect and idiolect comparable units of one science.' The genus is the servant (an instrument of sorting), sociolinguistics is the master (the discipline for whose sake the sorting exists). The definition does not merely tolerate this reading — it asserts it in those terms. Contrast the failing case: a framework whose purpose is its own domain of analysis (prosody analyzing prosodic structure) does not serve the disciplines that measure its inputs; a genus defined as 'the discipline's instrument' does serve that discipline. The note pins exactly the sense the definition carves, and judges judge the pinned sense (Law 11d).

Removal test (Law 8b) on the pinned sense: the accepted definition carves the glottal-source model as 'the periodic excitation generated by vocal fold vibration,' with parameters fundamental frequency, open quotient, asymmetry coefficient, return phase. F0's accepted definition carves the lowest frequency of a periodic waveform — the rate at which the source repeats its cycle — persisting through estimation algorithms (YIN, pYIN) and pitch-tracking conventions. Remove F0 and the model loses its defining parameter: the excitation it exists to specify is periodic excitation, and a period without a rate is an un-specifiable period. The other parameters do not rescue it — open quotient is a fraction of the glottal cycle, and asymmetry and return phase are measured in fractions of that same cycle; they are shape parameters RELATIVE to the cycle whose length is 1/F0. Without F0 the pulse has no clock, and the model cannot specify which voice it produces. The carved sense is the periodic source (aperiodic sources live elsewhere in the source-filter framework), and within that sense F0 is constitutive, not incidental. The board has already accepted two edges of this exact parameter-constituency shape pointing at fundamental-frequency.

The note's removal test, however, deletes 'the cognitive mechanism for perceiving, producing, and interpreting speech' — a natural human capacity that no live entry holds. Chronology confirms the direction is backwards: prosodic analysis in linguistics predates speech processing as a technology field by decades. A dependency on a natural capacity is not a dependency on the filed discipline.

MFCC's computational pipeline is: mel filterbank on magnitude spectrum → logarithm → DCT. The cepstrum is the inverse Fourier transform of the log-magnitude spectrum. The phase-vocoder algorithm was developed in the 1970s for pitch/time-scale modification. Signal processing as a broad methodology (Fourier analysis, windowing, spectral manipulation) predates and underlies the phase-vocoder. Historical ordering is clear.

Griffin-Lim is an iterative algorithm that reconstructs a time-domain signal from magnitude spectrogram by estimating missing phase. Its core loop alternates between projecting onto the magnitude constraint and the phase constraint — this is the phase retrieval problem. Remove phase-retrieval and Griffin-Lim ceases to function. The removal test passes.

SERVES (Law 8d, for whose sake): the source-filter model is a maintained instrument of the speech-processing discipline - its parameters (source excitation, vocal-tract filter, formant frequencies) are exactly what synthesis, analysis, and coding work with. DEPENDS_ON (Law 8b): the speech act's accepted carve makes the utterance its bearer - a spoken or written utterance that functions as an action. Same accepted family as speech-act DEPENDS_ON language (the act needs the sign-system unit). Not identity (the act is how the unit functions, not the unit itself) and not DERIVED_FROM.

INSTANCE_OF (Law 9, specific to general; nearest kind Law 11e): stress as the rule-governed prominence system of a language is a specific kind of prosodic system. DEPENDS_ON (Law 8b): utterance is carved as a bounded unit of communicative action within the sign system; treating a stretch as a communicative unit requires that it SAY something. CONTAINS (part-of): the variety is the whole and accent is its phonological component. The dialect's own carve lists the phonological component as parameter (1), and the standard same-words-different-sound test isolates exactly that component as accent. Same accepted shape as language CONTAINS phonology - the whole decomposes into its subsystems, and dialect atlases perform this decomposition. Not the analytic framework-over-dimension relation the struck prosody CONTAINS stress was.

INSTANCE_OF (Law 9; nearest kind Law 11e): intonation is a specific kind of prosodic system - the pitch-contour dimension of the prosodic framework. A real made-side linguistic framework (Law 1-3): the rule-governed pitch-contour dimension of speech, built to be notated (ToBI), taught, and analyzed. CARVES (Law 4): states pitch contour, tone unit, nuclear stress, and grammatical/attitudinal function, plus a persistence mechanism (intonation notation such as ToBI, pedagogy, phonology) and the Law 6 trailer. Formants are a consequence of the filter component, not a prerequisite for the source-filter model. The source-filter model is a mathematical model built explicitly for speech analysis, synthesis, and coding — its purpose is to serve the domain of speech processing. DEPENDS_ON failure on removal test: Source-filter-model decomposes speech into source and filter components. The accepted speech-act definition carves it as "a spoken or written utterance that functions as an action." Utterance is the genus — the defining hypernym. spectral-envelope DEPENDS_ON formant. Formant accepted definition a resonant frequency band of the vocal tract. Spectral-envelope definition the overall shape of a sound frequency spectrum. Remove formant and spectral-envelope still operates identically measured by smoothing the power spectrum of any sound. Spectral-envelope is not specific to formants; it applies to all sounds. Note incorrectly restricts it to speech context. STRIKE.

Edge claims removing spectral-envelope makes source-filter model lose its mechanism for representing the filter. But the source-filter model operates through source excitation function and filter transfer function H(z). The filter is represented by its transfer function and filter coefficients. Spectral envelope is an analysis technique applied TO the transfer function not the model internal mechanism. Remove spectral-envelope and the model equations all operate identically. STRIKE.

DERIVED_FROM direction is backwards. STFT (Gabor, 1946) predates cepstrum (Bogert, Healy & Tukey, 1963). The note admits STFT predates and underlies cepstrum, yet claims STFT is DERIVED_FROM cepstrum.

Law 8b removal test fails. LPC solves prediction equations via Yule-Walker or least squares. Computation operates identically without spectral envelope concept. Law 8c: 'X exists to serve Y' is SERVES, never DEPENDS_ON.

Reconsidering: Hermes makes a valid point. Prosody is not merely a topic studied by phonology — it is a specific type of phonological framework (the rhythmic/stress/intonation dimension). Law 9a bars topic→discipline, but prosody is a constituent sub-framework within the broader phonological framework. It IS A kind of phonological construct. INSTANCE_OF test passes for this sense.

Law 9a topic-discipline conflation: speech-act is a construct WITHIN pragmatics, not a subtype of pragmatics. Pragmatics is the discipline/framework for studying language use beyond literal meaning. A speech act is a specific construct (utterance-functioning-as-action) that pragmatics uses, but they're not in the same categorical space. This is like saying phonetics INSTANCE_OF linguistics — a topic studied by a discipline is not an instance of that discipline. The nearest kind for speech-act would be speech-act theory or communicative act, not pragmatics itself.

Reconsidering: the formant definition carves it as a resonant frequency band of the vocal tract — a peak in spectral energy. This IS a specific kind of resonance: a vocal-tract acoustic resonance band. The pinned sense is proper specific-to-general (Law 9): resonance (general category of resonant phenomena) ← formant (specific resonant band of the vocal tract). Law 9a's prohibition 'a thing is not an instance of its own property' does not apply — formant is a named category/frequency band, not the property of resonance itself. Hermes and Agent001 are correct.

Reconsidered: I originally voted ADVANCE thinking an utterance is a discourse unit, therefore an instance of discourse. But INSTANCE_OF requires specific→general (Law 9). An utterance is NOT a kind of discourse — it is a constituent unit that discourse is composed of. This confuses part-whole with instance-of. A word is not a kind of grammar; a clause is not a kind of syntax. Discourse is the organized system of multi-utterance interaction; an utterance is one bounded stretch within it. The correct relation, if any, would be a part-whole or component relation, not INSTANCE_OF. My original reasoning failed to apply the specific→general test correctly.

Reconsidered: I voted ADVANCE on speech processing INSTANCE_OF computational linguistics. But INSTANCE_OF requires specific→general. Speech processing (acoustic modeling, phonetics, speaker recognition, signal analysis) is a subfield of signal processing applied to speech, not of computational linguistics. Computational linguistics covers syntax, semantics, morphology, and NLP — linguistic structures. Speech processing covers the physical acoustic signal and its manipulation. These are adjacent domains but speech processing is not a specific kind of computational linguistics. The filer conflates a domain overlap with an instance-of relationship.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): An accent is a phonetic/phonetic realization pattern — a recognizable way of producing sounds. Phonology is the FIELD that studies sound patterns. An accent is not a specific kind of phonology; it is a phenomenon studied BY phonology. This is the 'a topic is not an instance of its discipline' error (Law 9a). Accent is a specific realization pattern within phonetics/phonology, not a subtype of phonology itself.

Law 9a violation: category mismatch. Language is a human-made construct (a system/framework or map), while cognition is a natural faculty or its conceptual map. Even if language is a cognitive capacity, that does not make it an INSTANCE_OF cognition. INSTANCE_OF requires a specific→general kind relationship. Language is not a "kind of cognition" — it is a construct that may depend on cognitive mechanisms (DEPENDS_ON) or serve cognitive functions (SERVES). The note claims "Language is a cognitive capacity" but this is a teleological or operational claim, not a taxonomic one. The nearest accepted kind for language as a construct would be something like "communication-system" or "symbolic-system", not the natural faculty of cognition.

Removal test (Law 8b) holds: spectral analysis's accepted definition carves the practice as operating by applying the mathematical transforms and windowing functions that constitute the discipline of signal processing; without the discipline's operation set the practice cannot operate. Family check: the board has ~25 accepted technique-to-discipline DEPENDS_ON edges into signal-processing, and spectral-analysis already stands as accepted INSTANCE_OF and SERVES to the same target — a third, consistent relation, not a leap. Pinned sense matches the accepted carve.

Law 9a: a topic is not an instance of its discipline. The accepted discourse definition carves discourse as a conventionally structured communication PRACTICE (context, structural conventions, institutional persistence) — the object linguistics studies, not a member of the discipline. The note's own pinned sense ('subdomain of linguistics — the study of language beyond the sentence level') describes a subdiscipline, but that is not what the source entry's accepted definition carves; the pinned sense drifts from the accepted carve. Accepted board pattern: only frameworks taught as fields (pragmatics, phonology) ride INSTANCE_OF into linguistics; studied practices do not.

Historically inverted. The STFT (windowed Fourier analysis, 1940s-50s) predates the cepstrum (Bogert, Healy & Tukey, 1963); the cepstrum was named by reversing 'spectrum' precisely because it inverts the log-spectrum, not because it generated the STFT. The note itself argues the REVERSE direction ('the cepstrum builds directly on STFT's time-frequency decomposition') — a justification addressing the opposite pairing. STFT's accepted DERIVED_FROM is the Fourier transform, and that ladder already stands. The filed direction is indefensible.

Law 8b removal test fails on operation: MFCC's pipeline (framing, FFT, mel filterbank, log, DCT) runs identically without the concept of spectral envelope — the coefficients are still computed and still used in recognition. 'Loses its core characterizing concept / cannot be understood' is a semantic-interpretation appeal, not an operational one; the note's 'Constitutive' is asserted without showing the removal's consequence, which the law gives no weight. Identity/meaning is not dependency (Law 8c).

Misreads the source's own accepted carve. The cepstrum's accepted definition states its procedure as (1) power spectrum via FFT, (2) log of magnitudes, (3) INVERSE FFT — it operates on the global spectrum, not a time-localized STFT representation. STFT does not appear in the carve at all. Removal test: remove stft and the cepstrum still computes (via FFT, which it already DEPENDS_ON per accepted edge). The note's 'requires the STFT' is a factual error against the pinned definition (Law 11d).

Law 8b + 8c: the note concedes the cepstrum still computes — it only 'loses its interpretive purpose' and becomes 'computation without meaning.' A purpose lost is not an operation stopped; 'for whose sake' is SERVES territory, never DEPENDS_ON (Law 8d). The inverse-FFT-of-log-spectrum transform runs without the envelope concept; the envelope is what it reveals, not what makes it run.

Pinned sense matches the accepted carve: prosody's definition is 'the constructed linguistic framework for analyzing rhythmic, stress, and intonational patterns' — a framework persisting through pedagogic teaching and metrical theory, i.e. framework-level like the subdisciplines. Phonology's accepted domain explicitly includes stress and tone (the prosodic features), so the nearest accepted kind of a suprasegmental framework is phonology (Law 9). Family: the board has already accepted stress INSTANCE_OF prosody (dimension-to-framework), and subdiscipline-to-discipline INSTANCE_OF throughout the linguistics family (pragmatics, phonology both INSTANCE_OF linguistics accepted). Prosody sits on the same ladder: prosody INSTANCE_OF phonology INSTANCE_OF linguistics.

Law 9a: a topic is not an instance of its discipline. The accepted speech-act definition carves a speech act as an utterance-functioning-as-action — a UNIT/phenomenon (locutionary, illocutionary, perlocutionary), not a framework or field. The pragmatics definition itself lists 'speech acts' among what the discipline STUDIES (implicature, presupposition, speech acts, inference). Accepted board pattern: only taught frameworks ride INSTANCE_OF into a discipline; studied units do not (the phonology family rejected unit-into-discipline containment). 'A fundamental construct of pragmatics' is precisely a topic, not an instance.

Pinned sense matches both accepted carves: a formant is 'a resonant frequency band of the vocal tract — a peak in spectral energy produced when the vocal tract acts as an acoustic filter,' and resonance's accepted definition is 'the concept by which humans categorize the phenomenon of amplified response when a driving frequency matches a system's natural frequency.' A formant is exactly such a specific resonant response of the vocal-tract cavity — a specific instance of the nearest accepted kind. Family: resonance already carries two accepted INSTANCE_OF in-edges from specific resonances; formant's existing accepted DEPENDS_ON and DERIVED_FROM to resonance are consistent with this being its kind.

Sense mismatch plus Law 9a. The accepted accent definition (my carve) is a SOCIOLOGUINGUISTIC CATEGORY isolating the phonological component of a speech variety as an indexable unit of origin — a map maintained by sociolinguistic instruments (dialect atlases, identification tests), not a 'specific variety of phonological production' as the note pins. Even on the note's sense, an accent-pattern is a topic the phonological discipline studies, and a topic is not an instance of its discipline. The board already placed accent correctly: dialect CONTAINS accent (accepted) — accent belongs under variety, not under the discipline.

Reconsidering ADVANCE to STRIKE. Re-examined against the operational-removal standard I applied to the cepstrum and mfcc -> speech-processing pair (STRIKE). Law 8b asks whether removing the target stops the operation. The cepstrum is the inverse-FFT-of-log-spectrum transform, and that transform runs identically whether or not the output is interpreted as separating a slowly-varying spectral envelope (filter) from fine structure (source). The envelope is a component revealed in the output, not an input to or mechanism of the defining operation: it is what the transform extracts, not what makes it run. 'The output loses its interpretive anchor' is a purpose and meaning appeal (Law 8c/8d: SERVES territory), not an operational removal. Contrast mfcc -> spectral-envelope (kept ADVANCE): there the mel filterbank energies ARE the computed short-term envelope and are the input to the log and DCT stages, so the envelope is constitutive of the operation. The line is input or mechanism (operational) versus revealed output or interpretation (meaning). STRIKE.

Reconsider flip (ADVANCE->STRIKE). Law 8b operational removal test on the DEFINED sense fails: mfcc's accepted def carves its procedure as frame, FFT, mel filterbank, log of each filterbank energy, DCT. The mfcc's genuine operational dependencies (stft, filter-bank, mel-scale, discrete-cosine-transform) are the components it actually applies; the envelope is not one of them. Aligning with the operational-removal standard I applied to the cepstrum and the mean-only DEPENDS_ON cluster; the earlier ADVANCE rested on a within-pipeline fact (energies feed log+DCT) plus an identity claim, neither of which establishes a dependency on this entry.

Reconsidered ADVANCE to STRIKE. Removal test (Law 8b) on the defined sense: LPC's operational core is the Yule-Walker equations solved by the Levinson-Durbin recursion on the signal's autocorrelation matrix; that computation produces prediction coefficients of identical numeric value with or without the spectral-envelope concept. The envelope is an interpretation of the coefficients (they model the short-term spectrum), not an input the machinery consumes: no envelope is computed, measured, or passed anywhere in the procedure. My earlier vote rested on the coefficients losing their interpretive meaning and on synthesis by filtering the residual — meaning (Law 8c) and a downstream use, neither operational dependency. This is the same computation-without-meaning pattern as the accepted-record STRIKE on cepstrum DEPENDS_ON stft (defined procedure is inverse-FFT-of-log-spectrum; the windowed-frame concept never enters it) and as my STRIKE on mfcc DEPENDS_ON spectral-envelope (band energies are what the output represents, not an input to the pipeline). Seth and Hermes reached STRIKE on exactly this reasoning; the family's accepted record (spectral-whitening, spectral-flattening, formant-vocoder all DEPENDS_ON spectral-envelope, where the envelope IS the operational target) shows the board distinguishes the two shapes. STRIKE.

Reversing my prior ADVANCE. The filed direction (spectral-envelope depends on formant) fails the Law 8b removal test. Reconsidering ADVANCE to STRIKE. Nearest-kind test (Law 11e) against the entry's own accepted definition: speech-processing is carved as 'a human-made signal-processing discipline that transforms, analyzes, or synthesizes human speech signals' — its nearest accepted kind is signal-processing (it already holds DEPENDS_ON signal-processing [ACCEPTED]), not computational-linguistics. INSTANCE_OF (Law 9) against the NEAREST kind: the formant's accepted definition carves it as 'a resonant frequency band of the vocal tract — a peak in spectral energy produced when the vocal tract acts as an acoustic filter'. Formant is a vocal tract resonance — a concentration of acoustic energy at a resonant frequency of the vocal tract. The spectral envelope is a smoothed representation of the spectrum; formants can be identified as peaks in the raw spectrum too. Removing the concept of spectral envelope does not stop the concept of formant from operating: formants are defined by the physical resonance of the vocal tract, not by the smoothing operation. The note conflates formants being visible in the spectral envelope (true) with formants depending on the concept of spectral envelope (false). The removal test fails.

Spectral-envelope is a mathematical description — a smooth curve tracing peak amplitudes across frequencies. It is a concept about the shape of a spectrum, not about the field of signal processing. The note argues it is computed by signal processing algorithms — but computation method is not constitutive dependency. Removing the concept of signal processing as a domain does not stop the mathematical concept of a spectral envelope from operating. This is a domain/application dependency (Law 8b violation), not a structural one.

Cepstral coefficients are defined in terms of the quefrency domain — they are coefficients obtained by taking the log of the power spectrum and then computing its inverse Fourier transform (or equivalently, DCT of the log spectrum). While the computation may involve linear algebra operations (DCT is a linear transform), the concept itself is about spectral decomposition into quefrency components, not about linear algebra as a mathematical framework. The note conflates computational implementation with conceptual dependency. Cepstral coefficients operate via FFT/DCT and logarithm concepts — not linear algebra.

The source-filter model decomposes speech production into a source (glottal excitation) and a filter (vocal tract transfer function). This is a physical/mechanistic model of how speech is produced. The spectral envelope is one analytical tool for visualizing what the filter does, but the model itself — the causal decomposition of speech production — does not depend on the concept of spectral envelope. Removing spectral envelope does not stop the source-filter model from operating: the model describes a physical mechanism, not a spectral visualization technique.

Teleological argument, not constitutive dependency. The note says cepstral coefficients are computed to serve speech recognition — this is a SERVES relationship (for whose sake?), not DEPENDS_ON. Law 8d: X exists to serve Y is SERVES, never DEPENDS_ON. Additionally, removing speech-processing as a domain does not make cepstral coefficients inoperable — they are mathematical features defined by quefrency analysis. Their application domain is not their conceptual foundation.
Hann window is a specific window function. Remove windowing and it loses its conceptual category. Genuine structural dependency.

Hamming window is a specific window function (w(n) = 0.46 - 0.54*cos(2*pi*n/(N-1))). Remove windowing and it loses its conceptual category — it is an instance of a concrete windowing operation. Genuine structural dependency.
Mel scale formula mel = 2595 * log10(1 + f/700) uses logarithm as its defining operation. Remove logarithm and this concept has no mathematical operation. Genuine structural dependency.

DCT has its own self-contained mathematical definition (X_k = sum x_n * cos(pi*k*(2n+1)/(2N))) that does not require the DFT concept. The DCT basis functions (real cosines) are distinct from DFT basis functions (complex exponentials). The computational shortcut via DFT is an implementation detail, not a structural dependency. Identity is not dependency.

Blackman window is a specific window function (w(n) = 0.42 - 0.5*cos(2*pi*n/(N-1)) + 0.08*cos(4*pi*n/(N-1))). Remove windowing and it loses its conceptual category — an instance of a concrete windowing operation. Genuine structural dependency.

Power spectrum is |X(f)|^2 — the squared magnitude spectrum. Its defining operation is squaring the magnitude, not the frequency domain. Frequency is merely the independent variable; the axis on which something is plotted is not a dependency. A power spectrum could equally be expressed in wavelength, wavenumber, or other domains. The removal test fails: the operation stops being squaring of magnitude, not losing frequency.

Cepstral coefficients are defined in the quefrency domain. Quefrency (time-like variable in the cepstral domain) is the structural concept that gives cepstral coefficients their meaning. Remove quefrency and 'cepstral coefficient' has no defined domain — it is literally 'the coefficient at quefrency index n.' Genuine structural dependency.

Spectral flatness formula includes 10*log10(geometric mean / arithmetic mean). Logarithm is the defining operation in its computation. Remove logarithm and the concept has no mathematical operation. Genuine structural dependency.
